Instruct: Now get a microwave safe mug or bowl for the egg.
Instruct: Now, crack one eggs into the mug.
Instruct: Now, add a pinch of salt to the egg in the mug.
Instruct: Now whisk the egg mixture until it is fully blended.
Instruct: Now put the egg in the microwave and cook for around 30 seconds.
Instruct: You can take out the egg and cut it into two equal parts. Then put one part of the egg on each slice.
